title: Migration supports jobs and economies with safe pathways
discussion_signal: IOM’s public discussion presents well-managed migration, safe pathways, regional cooperation, and reliable data as ways migration can support jobs, growth, and social cohesion while responding to disruption.
linked_research_question: How do pathway design, regional cooperation, and data infrastructure determine whether migration functions as a development asset or a source of unequal risk?
limits: The post is an institutional launch discussion rather than a representative migrant account
It does not quantify displacement or pathway access
The positive framing does not resolve political conflict over admission, rights, or distribution
